== Description ==

[[Logan Pietig]] (right, brown hair, black UWL hoodie, looking at cards), [[Mike Turner]] (left, tan cap, name tag, looking at cards), [[Steve Harpster]] (mid-left, white hair, glasses, black jacket), and [[Robbie Hendon]] (mid-right, grey SWCCG cap, grey T-shirt) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
